extractions.value: Clinical features (stiffness, spasms, lumbar hyperlordosis), EMG findings (continuous motor unit activity, exaggerated cutaneo-muscular reflexes), exclusion of mimics (myotonia, neuromyotonia, encephalomyelitis, CNS lesions), negative antibody screening
extractions.quote: The EMG findings, i.e. continuous activity of normal motor units and exaggerated cutaneo-muscular reflexes, not seen in other common causes of muscle tightness such as dystonia or spasticity (7), advocated in favour of SPS. Myotonia and neuromyotonia were excluded by the EMG results. Encephalomyelitis of inflammatory or paraneoplastic nature and local lesions of CNS, known to cause similar motor disturbances (1, 3), were also excluded by the absence of signs of brainstem or long tracks dysfunction and supportive laboratory results.
This case bears close similarity to SPS, including the characteristic lumbar lordosis

extractions.value: Patient had multiple pituitary hormone deficiencies due to postpartum pituitary necrosis (Sheehan syndrome). Symptoms persisted during sleep, unlike classical SPS. Upper trunk musculature was spared. Complete resolution with hormone replacement therapy.
extractions.quote: unlike the classical syndrome, the symptoms persisted during sleep and the upper trunk musculature was spared
